issues.on_page: Taxes: Other 16,729.46 (p4); Statement of Activities p2 prints 'Homestead/other'
issues.issue: the printed label is mixed ('Homestead/other'), so not all of it is necessarily homestead exemption. The category is defensible but is a judgment call. The same applies to detail[2] and detail[16].

the same label is categorized differently in the statement line and in detail: the Water part is charges for services/fees (detail[23]), the Sewer part is other (detail[30]), and the total line is other. Statement of Activities p2 counts the Water part in Charges for Services and the Sewer part in Operating Grants and Contributions.

issues.on_page: Sewer Other 39,222.67; p2 Sewer Operating Grants and Contributions 39,222.67
issues.issue: the Statement of Activities shows this amount as operating grants and contributions, so a grant/intergovernmental category could fit better than other.
